metadata.notes: West Virginia has 2 confirmed library tool lending programs. Kanawha County PL (Charleston) lends tools from hammers to cement mixers; max 7 items (2 power, 5 hand) for 14-day loan. Clarksburg-Harrison PL lends tools, STEM kits, outdoor equipment, and board games. Summers County PL also added utility wagons per ALA 2023 report but no detailed catalog was found online.
